ex.en: Hang your coat on the rack.
ex.zh: 把你的外套掛在衣架上。

ex.en: Put your bag on the luggage rack.
ex.zh: 把你的包包放在行李架上。

rack.en: a frame or shelf for holding or hanging things

rack.zh: rack up：累積（業績、分數、債務）

ex.en: When one of my coworkers starts racking up good sales figures I can't let down my guard.
ex.zh: 同期的同事開始衝出好業績時，我也不能鬆懈。

ex.en: He racked up a lot of credit card debt.
ex.zh: 他累積了一大筆卡債。

rack.en: to gain or collect a large number or amount of something

ex.en: I racked my brain, but I couldn't remember her name.
ex.zh: 我絞盡腦汁，還是想不起她的名字。

ex.en: We racked our brains for a new slogan.
ex.zh: 我們絞盡腦汁想新的口號。

rack.en: to think very hard about something

ex.en: Ultraviolet rays can cause skin cancer.
ex.zh: 紫外線可能導致皮膚癌。

ex.en: A ray of sunlight came through the window.
ex.zh: 一道陽光從窗戶照進來。

ray.en: a thin line of light or energy

ex.en: There is still a ray of hope.
ex.zh: 還有一線希望。

ex.en: The news brought a ray of hope to the family.
ex.zh: 這個消息為這家人帶來了一線希望。

ray.en: a small amount of something good, such as hope

ex.en: We had a heavy rainfall last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚雨下得很大。

ex.en: The area gets very little rainfall in winter.
ex.zh: 這個地區冬天降雨量很少。

ex.en: Heavy rainfall caused flooding in the south.
ex.zh: 豪雨在南部造成淹水。

rainfall.en: the amount of water that falls from the sky as drops in a certain time

ex.en: The red lines on the map represent a railway.
ex.zh: 地圖上的紅線代表鐵路。

ex.en: My dad works on the railways.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在鐵路局工作。

ex.en: My parents have just arrived at the railway station.
ex.zh: 我爸媽剛到火車站。

railway.en: a track of steel bars on which trains travel

ex.en: You had better put on a raincoat.
ex.zh: 你最好穿件雨衣。

ex.en: Who's the girl in a yellow raincoat?
ex.zh: 穿黃色雨衣的那個女孩是誰？

raincoat.en: a light coat that keeps you dry in wet weather

ex.en: His argument is rational.
ex.zh: 他的論點很合理。

ex.en: Maintain rational thought.
ex.zh: 保持理性思考。

ex.en: Let's try to make a rational decision.
ex.zh: 我們試著做個理性的決定吧。

rational.en: based on clear thought and good reasons

ex.en: Thousands of people attended the rally.
ex.zh: 數千人參加了這場集會。

ex.en: The union held a rally outside the factory.
ex.zh: 工會在工廠外舉行集會。

rally.en: a large public meeting to show support for something

ex.en: The stock market rallied after the news.
ex.zh: 消息傳出後股市反彈。

ex.en: Oil prices rallied in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 油價在午後回升。

rally.en: to rise again after a fall in price or value

ex.en: The manager rallied the team before the deadline.
ex.zh: 經理在截止日前凝聚了團隊士氣。

ex.en: Friends rallied around her when she was sick.
ex.zh: 她生病時朋友們都來支持她。

rally.en: to bring people together to support a person or cause

ex.en: The police carried out a raid on the warehouse.
ex.zh: 警方突襲搜查了那間倉庫。

ex.en: Several people were arrested in the raid.
ex.zh: 有好幾個人在這次突襲中被逮捕。

raid.en: a sudden attack or a search by the police

ex.en: Police raided the office early this morning.
ex.zh: 警方今天清晨突襲搜查了那間辦公室。

ex.en: The kids raided the fridge after school.
ex.zh: 孩子們放學後把冰箱搜刮一空。

raid.en: to enter a place suddenly to search it, or to take things from it

ex.en: Can you explain the rationale behind this decision?
ex.zh: 你能說明這個決定背後的理由嗎？

ex.en: The rationale for the price increase is unclear.
ex.zh: 漲價的理由並不清楚。

rationale.en: the reasons or ideas behind a decision or action

ex.en: Each soldier received a daily ration of food.
ex.zh: 每個士兵每天都領到定量的食物。

ex.en: Water rations were given to everyone.
ex.zh: 每個人都分到了配給的水。

ration.en: a fixed amount of food or supplies that one person is allowed

ex.en: The government rationed fuel during the crisis.
ex.zh: 危機期間政府實施燃料配給。

ex.en: I ration my coffee to two cups a day.
ex.zh: 我限制自己一天只喝兩杯咖啡。

ration.en: to allow people to have only a limited amount of something

ex.en: He is boiling with rage.
ex.zh: 他氣得怒火中燒。

ex.en: He flew into a rage when he saw the bill.
ex.zh: 他看到帳單時勃然大怒。

rage.zh: （火勢、爭論、疾病等）猛烈進行、肆虐

ex.en: War is like a raging fire.
ex.zh: 戰爭就像熊熊烈火。

ex.en: The debate is still raging online.
ex.zh: 這場爭論在網路上仍然吵得沸沸揚揚。

rage.en: to continue with great force or violence

rage.zh: all the rage：風靡一時、非常流行

ex.en: Bubble tea is all the rage in Europe.
ex.zh: 珍珠奶茶在歐洲非常流行。

ex.en: These sneakers were all the rage last year.
ex.zh: 這款球鞋去年風靡一時。

rage.en: very popular for a short time

ex.en: Rape is a serious crime in every country.
ex.zh: 在每個國家，強暴都是重罪。

ex.en: The organization supports victims of rape.
ex.zh: 這個組織協助性侵受害者。

rape.en: the crime of forcing someone to have sex (offensive)

ex.en: Farmers grow rape for its oil-rich seeds.
ex.zh: 農民種植油菜是為了它富含油脂的種子。

ex.en: Fields of yellow rape flowers bloom in spring.
ex.zh: 春天時一片片黃色的油菜花盛開。

rape.en: a yellow-flowered plant grown for its oil

randomly.zh: 隨機地、隨意地；莫名其妙地

ex.en: The winners will be randomly selected.
ex.zh: 得獎者將隨機抽出。

ex.en: My phone randomly shuts down sometimes.
ex.zh: 我的手機有時候會莫名其妙地關機。

randomly.en: without a plan or pattern, so that anything could be chosen

ex.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
ex.zh: 我寧願待在家，也不想出門。

ex.en: I'd rather not sleep and finish reading this book.
ex.zh: 我寧願不睡覺，也要把這本書看完。

rather.en: used to say what you prefer to do

ex.en: The doctor thought the patient's pulse was rather rapid.
ex.zh: 醫生覺得病人的脈搏有點快。

ex.en: My first day in the university was rather boring.
ex.zh: 我上大學的第一天相當無聊。

ex.en: Cutting a cake into equal pieces is rather difficult.
ex.zh: 把蛋糕切成一樣大小相當困難。

rather.en: to a fairly large degree, often more than expected

ex.en: We had better go home rather than wait here.
ex.zh: 我們最好回家，而不是在這裡等。

ex.en: Let's take the train rather than drive.
ex.zh: 我們搭火車吧，不要開車。

rather.en: used to show the thing that is not chosen or not done

ex.en: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
ex.zh: 房東說他想調漲房租。

ex.en: They monopolized the supply market and drastically raised prices.
ex.zh: 他們壟斷了供應市場，大幅提高價格。

ex.en: The company raised prices by ten percent.
ex.zh: 公司把價格調漲了一成。

raise.en: to make an amount or level higher

ex.en: If you have a thought, please raise your hand.
ex.zh: 如果你有想法，請舉手。

ex.en: Let's raise our glasses for a toast!
ex.zh: 我們舉杯敬酒吧！

raise.en: to lift something to a higher position

ex.en: Politicians are good at raising money.
ex.zh: 政客都很會募款。

ex.en: We raised money for the local hospital.
ex.zh: 我們為當地醫院募款。

raise.en: to collect money from other people for a purpose

ex.en: She raised an important question at the meeting.
ex.zh: 她在會議上提出一個重要問題。

ex.en: Does anyone want to raise any concerns?
ex.zh: 有人想提出任何疑慮嗎？

raise.en: to bring up a subject for people to talk about

ex.en: I asked my boss for a raise.
ex.zh: 我向主管要求加薪。

ex.en: She got a raise last month.
ex.zh: 她上個月加薪了。

raise.en: an increase in the money you earn

ex.en: We discussed a wide range of topics.
ex.zh: 我們討論了各式各樣的話題。

ex.en: We do have something which is more in your price range.
ex.zh: 我們確實有更符合您預算的產品。

ex.en: We offer a wide range of products.
ex.zh: 我們提供各式各樣的產品。

range.en: a group of different things of the same general type

ex.en: Prices range from 100 to 500 dollars.
ex.zh: 價格從一百元到五百元不等。

ex.en: Our customers range in age from 20 to 60.
ex.zh: 我們的客戶年齡從二十歲到六十歲都有。

range.en: to vary between a lowest and a highest amount

ex.en: The Himalayas are a mountain range located on the Asian continent.
ex.zh: 喜馬拉雅山脈位於亞洲大陸。

ex.en: The village sits at the foot of a mountain range.
ex.zh: 那個村莊位在山脈腳下。

range.en: a line of mountains or hills

ex.en: The weather will delay the start of the race.
ex.zh: 因為天氣的關係，比賽將延後開始。

ex.en: We went to the races.
ex.zh: 我們去看了比賽。

ex.en: Tom finished second in the race.
ex.zh: 湯姆在比賽中得到第二名。

race.en: a competition to see who is fastest

ex.en: A hare raced with a tortoise.
ex.zh: 兔子和烏龜賽跑。

ex.en: We raced toward the fire.
ex.zh: 我們急忙衝向火場。

race.en: to compete in a contest of speed, or to move very fast

ex.en: The law protects people of every race.
ex.zh: 法律保護所有種族的人。

ex.en: People of all races are welcome here.
ex.zh: 這裡歡迎各種族的人。

race.en: one of the main groups that people are divided into by skin color or origin

ex.en: Turn up the radio. I can't hear it.
ex.zh: 把收音機開大聲一點，我聽不到。

ex.en: According to the radio, it will snow tomorrow.
ex.zh: 根據廣播，明天會下雪。

ex.en: I often spend my leisure time listening to the radio.
ex.zh: 我閒暇時常聽廣播。

radio.en: a machine that receives sound programs, or the programs it plays

ex.en: It's raining, but I would like to go out.
ex.zh: 現在在下雨，但我想出門。

ex.en: Even if it rains, the game will be played.
ex.zh: 就算下雨，比賽也照常進行。

ex.en: The barometer is falling. It is going to rain.
ex.zh: 氣壓計在下降，要下雨了。

rain.en: to fall as drops of water from the sky

ex.en: The picnic was called off because of the rain.
ex.zh: 野餐因為下雨取消了。

ex.en: Heavy rain is expected this afternoon.
ex.zh: 預計今天下午會下大雨。

rain.en: drops of water that fall from the sky

ex.en: This firm ranks second in the oil trade.
ex.zh: 這家公司在石油業排名第二。

ex.en: The university ranks among the top 100 in the world.
ex.zh: 這所大學名列全球前一百名。

rank.en: to have a position in a list from highest to lowest

ex.en: He is immediately above me in rank.
ex.zh: 他的級別比我高一級。

ex.en: My brother’s in the army. He was just promoted to the rank of major.
ex.zh: 我哥哥在從軍，他剛升為少校。

rank.en: a level or position in a group or the army

ex.en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.
ex.zh: 月食是一種罕見的現象。

ex.en: It's rare to meet nice people like you.
ex.zh: 很少能遇到像你這麼好的人。

ex.en: It's rare for him to be late.
ex.zh: 他很少遲到。

ex.en: I'd like my steak rare, please.
ex.zh: 我的牛排要三分熟，謝謝。

ex.en: Do you prefer your beef rare or well-done?
ex.zh: 你的牛肉要三分熟還是全熟？

rare.en: cooked for a short time so that the inside is still red

ex.en: That market has been rapidly expanding.
ex.zh: 那個市場一直在迅速擴大。

ex.en: World population has rapidly increased.
ex.zh: 世界人口急速增加。

ex.en: I felt my heart beating rapidly.
ex.zh: 我感覺到心跳得很快。

ex.en: English people rarely talk to strangers in the train.
ex.zh: 英國人在火車上很少和陌生人說話。

ex.en: When writing English, she rarely makes a mistake.
ex.zh: 她寫英文時很少出錯。

ex.en: It's not wrong, but it's rarely written like that.
ex.zh: 這樣寫沒錯，只是很少人這樣寫。

ex.en: The application allows you to quickly calculate the ratio of body mass index - BMI.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式能讓你快速算出身體質量指數（BMI）。

ex.en: The ratio of students to teachers is twenty to one.
ex.zh: 學生與老師的比例是二十比一。

ex.en: The ratio of men to women in our office is about equal.
ex.zh: 我們辦公室的男女比例差不多。

ratio.en: the relationship between two amounts, showing how many times one contains the other

ex.en: The company needs a radical change in strategy.
ex.zh: 公司需要徹底改變策略。

ex.en: The new manager made radical changes to the team.
ex.zh: 新經理對團隊做了大刀闊斧的改變。

ex.en: She has a very radical opinion about the problem.
ex.zh: 她對這個問題有很激進的看法。

ex.en: What's radical today may be cliché tomorrow.
ex.zh: 今天的激進，明天可能就成了老生常談。

radical.en: wanting great changes in society, in a way many people find extreme

ex.en: The basic components of Chinese characters are called "radicals".
ex.zh: 漢字的基本組成單位叫做「部首」。

ex.en: The radical in the Chinese character for "good" is the character for "woman".
ex.zh: 「好」的部首是「女」。

radical.en: a basic part of a Chinese character used to look it up in a dictionary

ex.en: We're amazed by the rapid growth in import quantities.
ex.zh: 進口量的快速成長讓我們很驚訝。

ex.en: The development of the computer industry has been very rapid.
ex.zh: 電腦產業發展得非常快速。

ex.en: I'm amazed at his rapid progress in English.
ex.zh: 他英文進步得那麼快，讓我很驚訝。

ex.en: The winners were chosen in a random draw.
ex.zh: 得獎者是隨機抽出來的。

ex.en: We asked a random group of customers.
ex.zh: 我們隨機詢問了一群顧客。

random.en: chosen or happening without any plan or pattern

ex.en: Choose three books at random.
ex.zh: 隨便選三本書。

ex.en: Names were picked at random.
ex.zh: 名字是隨機抽選的。

random.en: without any plan, so that anything could be chosen

random.zh: 莫名其妙的、不相干的（口語）

ex.en: He said something totally random.
ex.zh: 他說了一句完全莫名其妙的話。

ex.en: A random guy started talking to me on the bus.
ex.zh: 公車上一個陌生人突然跟我聊起來。

random.en: strange or unconnected to what came before (informal)

ex.en: The UK must improve the problems with its rail network.
ex.zh: 英國必須改善鐵路網的問題。

ex.en: Is it convenient to transfer between the subway and the light rail here?
ex.zh: 這裡在捷運和輕軌之間轉乘方便嗎？

ex.en: Traveling by rail is cheaper than flying.
ex.zh: 搭火車旅行比搭飛機便宜。

rail.en: a track of steel bars for trains, or the train system

ex.en: Please hold the rail on the stairs.
ex.zh: 走樓梯時請扶好扶手。

ex.en: She leaned on the rail and looked at the sea.
ex.zh: 她靠在欄杆上看著大海。

rail.en: a bar that you can hold for support or safety

ex.en: People are concerned about racial problems.
ex.zh: 人們很關心種族問題。

ex.en: He fought against racial discrimination.
ex.zh: 他對抗種族歧視。

ex.en: The city is known for its racial diversity.
ex.zh: 這座城市以種族多元聞名。

racial.en: relating to the groups people are divided into by skin color or origin

ex.en: I can't eat raw eggs; they must be cooked.
ex.zh: 我不能吃生蛋，一定要煮熟。

ex.en: Eating raw eggs could be bad for you.
ex.zh: 吃生蛋可能對身體不好。

ex.en: We often eat fish raw in Japan.
ex.zh: 在日本我們常吃生魚。

raw.zh: 未加工的、原始的（raw material 原料、raw data 原始資料）

ex.en: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
ex.zh: 日本從國外進口各種原料。

ex.en: We need to analyze the raw data first.
ex.zh: 我們得先分析原始資料。

raw.en: in its natural state and not yet processed or changed

ex.en: My throat feels dry and raw and scratchy.
ex.zh: 我的喉嚨又乾又痛又癢。

ex.en: My hands were raw from the cold.
ex.zh: 我的手被凍得又紅又痛。

raw.en: red, sore and painful because the skin is damaged

ex.en: There are rats in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房裡有老鼠。

ex.en: The black cat is eating a white rat.
ex.zh: 黑貓在吃一隻白老鼠。

ex.en: Rats can spread disease.
ex.zh: 老鼠會傳播疾病。

rat.en: a small animal like a big mouse with a long tail

ex.en: The ship is not equipped with radar.
ex.zh: 這艘船沒有配備雷達。

ex.en: The plane suddenly disappeared from the radar.
ex.zh: 那架飛機突然從雷達上消失了。

radar.en: a system that uses radio waves to find the position of planes and ships

radar.zh: under the radar：不引人注意、低調地

ex.en: If he didn't order this investigation, she could have flown under the radar for years.
ex.zh: 要不是他下令展開調查，她可能好幾年都不會被發現。

ex.en: The startup stayed under the radar for years.
ex.zh: 這家新創公司低調了好幾年。

radar.en: not noticed by people or the public

ex.en: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
ex.zh: 平流層的臭氧會吸收紫外線輻射。

ex.en: Some patients receive radiation as part of cancer treatment.
ex.zh: 有些病人會接受放射線治療癌症。

radiation.en: energy sent out as waves or tiny particles, such as heat or light

ex.en: Find the radius of the incircle of the triangle.
ex.zh: 求這個三角形內切圓的半徑。

ex.en: The radius of the circle is five centimeters.
ex.zh: 這個圓的半徑是五公分。

radius.en: the distance from the center of a circle to its edge

ex.en: We deliver within a five-kilometer radius.
ex.zh: 我們的外送範圍是方圓五公里內。

ex.en: There are three hospitals within a ten-mile radius.
ex.zh: 方圓十英里內有三家醫院。

radius.en: the area within a certain distance from a point

ex.en: The app randomizes the order of the questions.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式會隨機排列題目順序。

ex.en: Participants were randomized into two groups.
ex.zh: 參與者被隨機分成兩組。

randomize.en: to arrange or choose things in no fixed order

ex.en: Fear can override rationality.
ex.zh: 恐懼可能壓過理性。

ex.en: Economists often assume the rationality of consumers.
ex.zh: 經濟學家常假設消費者是理性的。

rationality.en: the quality of being based on clear thought and good reasons

ex.en: The rancher raises cattle on his land in Texas.
ex.zh: 那位牧場主人在德州的土地上養牛。

ex.en: Ranchers are worried about the dry weather.
ex.zh: 牧場經營者很擔心乾旱的天氣。

rancher.en: a person who owns or runs a large farm for cattle or horses

ex.en: I'm busy tonight. Can I take a rain check?
ex.zh: 我今晚很忙，可以改天嗎？

ex.en: Thanks for the invite, but I'll have to take a rain check.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的邀請，不過我得改天了。

rain check.en: to say you cannot do something now but would like to do it later

ex.en: She quickly built a good rapport with her students.
ex.zh: 她很快就和學生建立了良好的關係。

ex.en: There's a natural rapport between the two hosts.
ex.zh: 兩位主持人之間有種自然的默契。

rapport.en: a close, friendly understanding between people

ex.en: It's a rainy day, so we can't play outside.
ex.zh: 今天下雨，我們不能出去玩。

ex.en: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
ex.zh: 下雨天容易發生交通事故。

ex.en: Do you go to school by bus on rainy days?
ex.zh: 下雨天你搭公車上學嗎？

rainy.en: having a lot of water falling from the sky

rainy.zh: save for a rainy day：未雨綢繆、存錢以備不時之需

ex.en: You'd better keep your money for a rainy day.
ex.zh: 你最好存點錢以備不時之需。

ex.en: It's smart to put some money aside for a rainy day.
ex.zh: 存點錢以備不時之需是很明智的。

rainy.en: to keep money for a time when you may need it

ex.en: Critics raved about the new film.
ex.zh: 評論家對這部新電影讚不絕口。

ex.en: Everyone is raving about the new restaurant downtown.
ex.zh: 大家都在熱烈稱讚市中心那家新餐廳。

rave.en: to talk about something with great excitement and praise

ex.zh: 他為了比賽買了一支新網球拍。

ex.en: She swung her racquet and hit the ball hard.
ex.zh: 她揮動球拍用力擊球。

ex.en: You little rascal, you ate all the cookies!
ex.zh: 你這個小搗蛋，把餅乾全吃光了！

ex.en: My grandfather calls the puppy a lovable rascal.
ex.zh: 我爺爺說那隻小狗是惹人愛的小調皮。

ex.en: The rascal cheated several old people out of their savings.
ex.zh: 那個無賴騙走了幾位老人的積蓄。

ex.en: The story is about a rascal who tricks the whole village.
ex.zh: 這故事講的是一個騙過全村人的無賴。

rated.zh: 評價；評分（rate 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: Critics rated the film four out of five stars.
ex.zh: 影評人給這部電影打了五顆星中的四顆。

ex.en: Customers rated the hotel very highly for its cleanliness.
ex.zh: 顧客對這間旅館的整潔給予很高的評價。

ex.en: It is the highest rated restaurant in our neighborhood.
ex.zh: 這是我們這一帶評價最高的餐廳。

ex.en: The movie is rated PG, so children can watch it.
ex.zh: 這部電影是輔導級，所以小孩可以看。

rambunctious.zh: 吵鬧難管的；活潑好動的

ex.en: The rambunctious puppy knocked over the lamp.
ex.zh: 那隻吵鬧好動的小狗撞倒了檯燈。

ex.en: Her rambunctious students never sit still.
ex.zh: 她那群活潑好動的學生從來坐不住。

ex.en: The guards struggled to control the rabble outside the gate.
ex.zh: 守衛努力控制門外的烏合之眾。

ex.en: He called the noisy crowd a rabble.
ex.zh: 他把那群吵鬧的人群稱為烏合之眾。

ex.en: He spoke in a raspy voice because of his cold.
ex.zh: 他因為感冒，說話聲音沙啞。

ex.en: The old singer's raspy tone suited the blues song.
ex.zh: 那位老歌手沙啞的嗓音很適合藍調歌曲。

rather than.zh: 而不是（A rather than B＝是 A 而不是 B）

ex.en: She chose a quiet job rather than a stressful one.
ex.zh: 她選了一份安靜的工作，而不是壓力大的工作。

ex.en: I prefer to cook at home rather than eat out.
ex.zh: 我比較喜歡在家煮飯，而不是出去吃。

ex.en: The problem is the schedule, rather than the people.
ex.zh: 問題出在時程，而不是人。

rather than.en: used to say B is not the thing that is true

ex.en: Rather than complain, why not try to fix it yourself?
ex.zh: 與其抱怨，何不自己試著修好它？

ex.en: Rather than wait for help, he decided to start working.
ex.zh: 他決定與其等人幫忙，不如自己動手做。

rather than.en: used to say you do one thing and not the other
